Privacy Policy

This page explains how SP WorldTech handles information submitted through this corporate website.

Information we receive

We may receive information you choose to send through email, contact requests, project enquiries or other business communications.

How we use information

Information is used to respond to enquiries, discuss projects, provide requested services, maintain website security and improve our business communications.

Third-party services

Some website features may use third-party services such as Google Maps or external links. Their own privacy policies govern information processed directly by those services.

Data security

We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect business communications and information. No internet transmission can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

Your choices

You may contact us to ask questions about information you have submitted to SP WorldTech.
